column11: [E1 Architecture] UI source of truth is design-ref. Routes: /projects, /projects/:id, /deployments/:id, /projects/:id/release/:channel, /projects/:id/rollback/:channel. Domain state follows source_event -> build_job -> artifact -> deployment -> release_channel/preview -> route_revision/audit_event. [E2 Implementation] Empty repo; scaffold TypeScript React/Vite operator console using design tokens, shared shell, panels, tables, status pills, timelines, log/evidence, release safety checks, audit reason forms. Use fixture-backed API boundary first; add Vitest and Playwright checks. [E3 Integration] Need API read models for projects, deployments, channels, artifacts, route revisions, logs, audit; polling/SSE boundaries for active build/route states; explicit loading/error/empty states. [E4 Risk] Guard secrets leakage, destructive promote/rollback, stale route/CDN state, rollback target eligibility, responsive/a11y density, missing tests, and file collision risk. Expected task count ceiling: 6 substantial feature-level tasks.
